tried: The request page for this dataset is wonder.cdc.gov/ucd-icd10-expanded.html, which opens dataset D158 ("Underlying Cause of Death, 2018-2024, Single Race"); the task's "D176" was not the id served on 21 Oct 2026.

Selecting the eight W codes and the two V codes in one query would have given a single combined total, so two queries were run: W65–W74 (its Total row is the block total asked for) and V90 plus V92 (its Total row is the watercraft total). WONDER lists V90 and V92 only as 4-character sub-codes by craft type, which is why the second query's rows are sub-codes.

Navigating straight back to the request form between queries dropped the session (WONDER answered "Access WONDER data by completing and submitting a request page"), so the data-use page was accepted a second time and the second query run from the fresh form.
notes: The first US setting split by ICD-10 code for 2024: of 4,201 unintentional drowning deaths (W65–W74, WONDER's total), natural water while in it 1,856 (W69) and after a fall 202 (W70); swimming pool 823 (W67) and after a fall 58 (W68); bath-tub 717 (W65) and after a fall 22 (W66); other specified 153 (W73); unspecified 370 (W74). Watercraft drownings (V90 and V92) are another 339 in a separate query and are not added. Suppression: no cell was suppressed in the W65–W74 query (every count is above nine); in the V90/V92 query eight sub-codes with counts of one to nine were suppressed and are not recorded, though WONDER's total includes them. Query settings for both: Group By = Cause of death; Year/Month = 2024; Show Totals = True; Show Zero Values = True; Show Suppressed = False; rates per 100,000; default populations; no age-adjusted rate requested; Query Dates Oct 21, 2026 10:48:11 AM and 10:49:20 AM (server time). Comparison with the MMWR series: the 2024 W65–W74 total sits below the 2019–2022 MMWR totals mainly because the MMWR counts W65–W74 together with V90 and V92; the MMWR's own 2024 figure, when published, is the comparable one. The data-use terms were accepted by the lab's owner in this session; nothing here is a count of nine or fewer. The data-use terms were accepted by the lab's owner for this session.
